cascade_nb2103_K28.method: residual_transfer: residual_K28_K28 = nb2103[unb] - chemprop_aux[unb]; cascade_tta = tta_mean[unb] + residual
cascade_nb2103_K28.caveat: Residuals were FIT on chemprop_aux; applying to TTA is naive transfer (not a re-fit). Decision-grade cascade requires retraining the 5-seed LGBM residual bag against TTA-mean as anchor (~17s).
